create_local_pipeline_executor: create a LocalPipelineExecutor to run a data processing pipeline locally with configurable tasks and workers
run_pipeline_locally: run a LocalPipelineExecutor pipeline with multiprocess workers and dependency support
configure_dependency_executor: configure a LocalPipelineExecutor to depend on another executor that must complete first
get_distributed_env_vars: get distributed environment variables for a local pipeline executor
skip_completed_tasks: skip already completed tasks when re-running a LocalPipelineExecutor with skip_completed enabled
